jurisdictionEvidence: SELECT e.*,s.source_code,sr.physical_locator FROM facility_jurisdiction_evidence e JOIN source_record sr USING(source_record_id) JOIN source s USING(source_id) LEFT JOIN logical_facility_member m ON m.member_facility_id=e.facility_id WHERE COALESCE(m.master_facility_id,e.facility_id)=?1
members: SELECT f.facility_id,f.canonical_name facility_name,f.facility_type category,COALESCE(l.road_address,l.address_raw) address,f.primary_capacity_value,f.primary_capacity_unit,f.primary_capacity_type,CASE WHEN f.facility_id=?1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END is_master FROM facility f LEFT JOIN facility_location l USING(location_id) WHERE f.facility_id=?1 OR f.facility_id IN(SELECT member_facility_id FROM logical_facility_member WHERE master_facility_id=?1) ORDER BY is_master DESC,f.facility_id
categories: SELECT c.category_type,c.is_primary,c.confidence_status,s.title source,s.source_year,sr.physical_locator,c.source_record_id,c.facility_id member_facility_id FROM facility_category c JOIN source_record sr USING(source_record_id) JOIN source s USING(source_id) WHERE c.facility_id=?1 OR c.facility_id IN(SELECT member_facility_id FROM logical_facility_member WHERE master_facility_id=?1) ORDER BY c.is_primary DESC,c.category_type,s.source_year DESC
capacities: SELECT c.capacity_type,c.value,c.unit,c.raw_value,c.observed_year,c.confidence_status,c.source_record_id,c.facility_id member_facility_id,s.source_code,CASE WHEN s.source_code='SRC_SLUDGE_FLOW_2024' THEN 'SEWAGE_SLUDGE' ELSE COALESCE((SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT category_type)=1 THEN MIN(category_type) END FROM facility_category WHERE facility_id=c.facility_id AND source_record_id=c.source_record_id),(SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT facility_type_candidate)=1 THEN MIN(facility_type_candidate) END FROM facility_candidate WHERE source_record_id=c.source_record_id)) END source_category FROM facility_capacity c JOIN source_record sr USING(source_record_id) JOIN source s USING(source_id) WHERE c.facility_id=?1 OR c.facility_id IN(SELECT member_facility_id FROM logical_facility_member WHERE master_facility_id=?1) ORDER BY c.observed_year DESC,c.capacity_type
organizations: SELECT o.organization_name,o.organization_type,fo.relationship_type,fo.raw_relationship_text,fo.review_status,fo.facility_id member_facility_id FROM facility_organization fo JOIN organization o USING(organization_id) WHERE fo.facility_id=?1 OR fo.facility_id IN(SELECT member_facility_id FROM logical_facility_member WHERE master_facility_id=?1) ORDER BY fo.relationship_type,o.organization_name
processes: SELECT p.process_type,p.process_name,p.status,p.confidence_status,sr.raw_payload,p.source_record_id,p.facility_id member_facility_id,s.source_code,CASE WHEN s.source_code='SRC_SLUDGE_FLOW_2024' THEN 'SEWAGE_SLUDGE' ELSE COALESCE((SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT category_type)=1 THEN MIN(category_type) END FROM facility_category WHERE facility_id=p.facility_id AND source_record_id=p.source_record_id),(SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT facility_type_candidate)=1 THEN MIN(facility_type_candidate) END FROM facility_candidate WHERE source_record_id=p.source_record_id)) END source_category FROM facility_process p JOIN source_record sr USING(source_record_id) JOIN source s USING(source_id) WHERE p.facility_id=?1 OR p.facility_id IN(SELECT member_facility_id FROM logical_facility_member WHERE master_facility_id=?1) ORDER BY s.source_code,p.process_type,p.process_name
observations: SELECT o.observation_id,o.process_id,o.observed_year,o.metric_type,o.value,o.unit,o.quality_status,o.confidence_status,o.source_record_id,o.facility_id member_facility_id,s.source_code,CASE WHEN s.source_code='SRC_SLUDGE_FLOW_2024' THEN 'SEWAGE_SLUDGE' ELSE COALESCE((SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT category_type)=1 THEN MIN(category_type) END FROM facility_category WHERE facility_id=o.facility_id AND source_record_id=o.source_record_id),(SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT facility_type_candidate)=1 THEN MIN(facility_type_candidate) END FROM facility_candidate WHERE source_record_id=o.source_record_id)) END source_category FROM facility_observation o JOIN source_record sr USING(source_record_id) JOIN source s USING(source_id) WHERE o.facility_id=?1 OR o.facility_id IN(SELECT member_facility_id FROM logical_facility_member WHERE master_facility_id=?1) ORDER BY o.observed_year DESC,o.metric_type
sources: SELECT s.title source,s.source_year year,s.file_path file,sr.sheet_name sheet,sr.page_number page,sr.row_number row_number,l.link_type,l.review_status,l.facility_id member_facility_id FROM facility_source_link l JOIN source_record sr USING(source_record_id) JOIN source s USING(source_id) WHERE l.facility_id=?1 OR l.facility_id IN(SELECT member_facility_id FROM logical_facility_member WHERE master_facility_id=?1) ORDER BY s.source_year DESC,s.title
relatedFacilities: WITH own(id) AS (SELECT ?1 UNION SELECT member_facility_id FROM logical_facility_member WHERE master_facility_id=?1), raw(id,relation_type) AS (SELECT CASE WHEN r.left_facility_id IN(SELECT id FROM own) THEN r.right_facility_id ELSE r.left_facility_id END,r.relation_type FROM facility_relation r WHERE r.relation_type='PROCESS_OF_FACILITY' AND (r.left_facility_id IN(SELECT id FROM own) OR r.right_facility_id IN(SELECT id FROM own))), mapped AS (SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(m.master_facility_id,raw.id) facility_id,raw.relation_type FROM raw LEFT JOIN logical_facility_member m ON m.member_facility_id=raw.id) SELECT mapped.relation_type,mapped.facility_id,f.canonical_name facility_name,f.facility_type category FROM mapped JOIN facility f USING(facility_id) WHERE mapped.facility_id!=?1 ORDER BY f.canonical_name,mapped.facility_id
provenance: SELECT observation_candidate_id,metric_key_raw FROM observation_candidate WHERE source_record_id IN (SELECT source_record_id FROM facility_observation WHERE facility_id=?1 OR facility_id IN (SELECT member_facility_id FROM logical_facility_member WHERE master_facility_id=?1))
facility: SELECT f.facility_id,f.canonical_name,f.facility_type,f.facility_subtype,f.facility_status,f.status_raw,f.primary_capacity_value,f.primary_capacity_unit,f.primary_capacity_type,f.commissioning_date,f.completion_date,f.closure_date,f.public_private,f.confidence_status,f.merge_status,COALESCE(l.road_address,l.address_raw),l.province_normalized,l.city_county_normalized,l.district_normalized,l.province_raw,l.city_county_raw,l.district_raw,(SELECT jurisdiction FROM logical_facility_jurisdiction j WHERE j.facility_id=f.facility_id) FROM facility f LEFT JOIN facility_location l USING(location_id) WHERE f.facility_id=?
